observations.environment_en: Chrome on macOS · desktop · no account
observations.environment_zh: macOS Chrome · 桌面 · 无账户
observations.summary_en: One local two-player round reached an X win.
observations.summary_zh: 一局本地双人游戏完成，X 获胜。

steps.action_en: Open a fresh board in the default two-player mode.
steps.result_en: The board was empty; X had the first turn and all score counters were zero.
steps.action_zh: 打开默认双人模式的新棋盘。
steps.result_zh: 棋盘为空，轮到 X，所有比分为零。

steps.action_en: Click cell 1, then click the occupied cell 1 again.
steps.result_en: The first click placed X and changed the turn to O. The second click did not replace X or change the turn.
steps.action_zh: 点击格子 1，再次点击已占用的格子 1。
steps.result_zh: 第一次点击放置 X 并切换到 O；第二次点击没有覆盖棋子或改变回合。

steps.action_en: Click cells 4, 2, 5 and 3, in that order.
steps.result_en: O and X alternated. X filled the top row; the page announced an X win and increased the X score to 1.
steps.result_zh: O 与 X 交替落子。X 占据首行，页面宣布 X 获胜，X 比分增加到 1。

steps.action_en: After the win, click the empty cell 9.
steps.result_en: Cell 9 stayed empty and the winner and score remained unchanged.
steps.result_zh: 格子 9 保持为空，胜方和比分没有变化。

observations.scope_en: Cells are numbered left to right, top to bottom. This covers one win, occupied-cell handling and terminal-state handling. Draws, computer-opponent strategy, saved scores, customization and mobile behavior were not tested; AI authorship remains the publisher’s claim.
observations.scope_zh: 格子按从左到右、从上到下编号。本记录覆盖一次获胜、已占用格子及终局处理；未测试平局、电脑对手策略、比分保存、自定义或手机表现。AI 开发方式仍依据发布者声明。

screenshot.caption_en: Observed final board: X across the top row and X score 1. Demo by OpenAI’s coding-example collection.
screenshot.caption_zh: 实际终局：X 占据首行，X 比分为 1。演示来自 OpenAI 编程案例集。

observations.environment_en: Chrome on macOS · desktop · no account
observations.environment_zh: macOS Chrome · 桌面 · 无账户
observations.summary_en: Product filtering opened the matching history page.
observations.summary_zh: 商品筛选可进入匹配的历史页面。

steps.action_en: Open the home page and choose Product Prices.
steps.result_en: The product table loaded with a search field and a note about products with at least six collected prices.
steps.action_zh: 打开首页并选择 Product Prices。
steps.result_zh: 商品表格加载，显示搜索框，以及至少收集六次价格的商品说明。

steps.result_en: The page displayed the matching-products message and a Large Eggs row.
steps.result_zh: 页面显示匹配商品说明及 Large Eggs 记录。

steps.result_en: The URL changed to /products/large-eggs. The Large Eggs heading, price chart and dated history table rendered. Some rows were explicitly labeled Estimate.
steps.action_zh: 打开 Large Eggs 链接。
steps.result_zh: 网址变为 /products/large-eggs；商品标题、价格图表和带日期的历史表格显示，部分行明确标注为 Estimate。

observations.scope_en: This checks navigation, filtering and visible history rendering only. It does not validate recorded prices, chart calculations, completeness, retailer coverage, freshness or mobile behavior. The chart’s right-edge price label was clipped in the captured desktop view.
observations.scope_zh: 仅检查导航、筛选及历史内容的可见呈现；未验证价格记录、图表计算、完整性、零售商覆盖、时效或手机表现。截图中的图表右侧价格标签有裁切。

screenshot.caption_en: Large Eggs history view after keyword filtering and navigation. Website by Jim Lawruk; displayed prices are not independently validated.
screenshot.caption_zh: 关键词筛选及跳转后的 Large Eggs 历史页面。网站由 Jim Lawruk 制作，图中价格未独立验证。
